scope: Optional browser storage, FCUNO/SPC session presentation, navigation and login/logout acknowledgement
confirmedFailures: Valid server sessions became signed out after quota/security errors writing optional actor metadata.
Unavailable storage could crash sidebar mount/toggles and prevent FCUNO logout from reaching the server.
SPC local login publication/clear stopped before emitting the state-change event when persistence threw.
SPC redirected and cleared local session after a failed server logout.
FCUNO login request/JSON failures left Signing in permanently disabled; acknowledged login could not continue if browser cache persistence failed.
implementation: Best-effort local storage for existing metadata/preferences, retaining latest failed-write value or failed-remove tombstone only in the current browser document.
All helper functions guard window before fallback access; server request data cannot enter or read the fallback.

Supabase client reads the same optional actor metadata so authenticated transport and audit routing still work when disk storage is unavailable. Server authentication, permissions and trusted audit actor remain unchanged.
FCUNO login catches failed requests/invalid replies, reenables retry, and preserves validated federation continuation rules.
SPC logout clears local state/redirects only after server acknowledgement; failed logout retains sign-in and offers retry.

candidate.independentReview: Passed; another agent read all seven changed runtime files and the actual server proxy boundary. Final expanded browser 12 and helper 4 checks were independently rerun after freeze, with unchanged hashes.

safety.browser: Dedicated headless browser and fresh isolated contexts only; closed after tests.
safety.network: Synthetic session/login/logout/proxy HTTP only. No real credentials, emails, cloud jobs or business-record mutations.
safety.source: Seven runtime files, three tests/fixture and narrow regression CI steps for shared storage/Exchange acknowledgement plus country/pricing; no package, lock, database schema, permission, federation protocol or provider configuration change.
safety.testRunnerRecovery: An attempted bundled pnpm script command unexpectedly moved 25 local dependency folders before failing. Every original folder was moved back without overwriting anything; all 25 declared package versions match the immutable lockfile. No dependency install completed and no package/lock edits resulted. Subsequent checks use direct Node only.

limits: Cached metadata remains a pre-existing optimistic UI hint, never authorization. Fresh server APIs decide access.
Browser storage failure in other feature-specific caches is not automatically covered by this shared metadata/preferences patch.
Synthetic client tests do not certify current hosted sessions, RLS, identity-provider availability or real Outlook execution.
Full development dependency audit has an unchanged braces advisory with no patched version; it is not hidden or disabled.
